claim_bearing_reason: H-EVAL-6 (SUPPORTED): nuScenes open-loop planning is inadmissible as a TanitAD criterion - no official protocol; the L2 averaging convention alone moves one VAD checkpoint 0.72 -> 1.22 m (+70 %) and flips the UniAD/VAD ranking; the GT human trajectory scores 0.36-0.96 % collision; the field's 'high-level command' is the GT future thresholded at +-2 m (our route-echo defect). D-BENCH-PORT (PI, 2026-08-29): SKIP claim-bearing. Usable ONLY as a cited external-comparability row.

loop.note: single-shot plan from t0 inputs scored against the logged future; nothing is ever driven (EVAL_DOCTRINE: only T2 is closed loop)

protocol.tier_note: single-shot plan from t0 inputs, scored against the logged future; nothing is driven (EVAL_DOCTRINE: only T2 is closed loop)

gt_control.note: RAW box collision of the GT human trajectory under this protocol's own grid (PARA-Drive fn. 4). The references EXCLUDE GT-colliding steps from every arm's numerator, so in-protocol the GT arm scores 0 by construction; this raw rate is the false-positive floor. PARA-Drive Table 8: UniAD protocol 0.36 %, VAD protocol 0.96 %. Quote no arm's collision within ~2x of it.

nonstraight.rule: GT-derived command != FORWARD (+-2 m final offset)

longitudinal.reason: along-track + speed error only; distance-keeping (headway/TTC to the lead agent) is not computed by this harness

lateral.reason: cross-track + heading error only; curvature and yaw-rate error at 0.5 s waypoint spacing are not computed

tactical.reason: manoeuvre decision = the +-2 m final-offset class of the plan vs the GT class (a LABEL, never an input); no goal-setting target

strategic.reason: the nuScenes open-loop protocol has no route/goal target; a route could come from the map expansion + CAN 'route' - not implemented

interval.reason: no cluster unit pre-registered for nuScenes (scene vs log); the published rows carry no interval either
